name: Flipcash USDF
oneLiner: USDF is Flipcash's dollar stablecoin and the first Coinbase Custom Stablecoin, collateralized 1:1 by USDC via Coinbase's stablecoin-as-a-service platform.
collateral: 1:1 collateralized by USDC via Coinbase's Custom Stablecoins platform; reserves managed by Coinbase infrastructure
pegMechanism: Coinbase Custom Stablecoin model: Coinbase handles issuance, redemption, custody, security, and compliance; USDF is designed to maintain a stable U.S. dollar value and relies on Coinbase-managed reserve backing and redemption mechanics

launchPhaseDetail: First Coinbase Custom Stablecoin; 1:1 collateralized by USDC via Coinbase's stablecoin-as-a-service platform; backend testing confirmed Jan 2026; Coinbase Custom Stablecoins lets any business launch branded coins backed by USDC
